title: Tolgee
name: tolgee
description: Localisation platform for translating your app's strings, with in-context editing, translation memory, machine translation, screenshots, import and export in most formats, and a CLI and SDKs to sync with your code. Source: https://github.com/tolgee/tolgee-platform

env.name: TOLGEE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (required)
env.description: Password for the admin account, which logs in with the username admin. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 16.

env.name: TOLGEE_DB_PASSWORD
env.label: Database password (required)
env.description: Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or Tolgee can't reach its database.

env.name: TOLGEE_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Fill in the admin password and database password before you deploy, since the stack won't start without them (openssl rand -hex 16 and openssl rand -hex 32). Give it a minute or so on first start, then open it on port 8085 and log in as admin with your password - the login box asks for an email, but admin works. There's a demo project to poke at. Sign-ups are closed, so invite people from a project's Members page, which hands you a link to send them. To open sign-ups, add TOLGEE_SIGNUPS = true to the stack's environment variables and redeploy. Once a day it sends Tolgee a count of your projects, languages, translations and users; add TOLGEE_TELEMETRY = false the same way to stop that. Translations live in Postgres (the postgres-data volume), screenshots and avatars in tolgee-data. Some features, like the AI translator and SSO, need a paid licence. Docs: docs.tolgee.io
